confirmed_properties.property: Capture rejects concurrent journal replacement without claiming latest state
confirmed_properties.reasoning: The bounded reader verifies the opened descriptor and final named file identity. Backup repeats exact journal/config/source reads before and after writing payload; scheduling verifies the complete generated package before replacing its selected record. Legitimate atomic daemon writes can refuse that capture. Existing selection is preserved until complete verified publication; an older completed generation is explicitly a point-in-time snapshot.

confirmed_properties.property: Sidecar lock exclusion does not freeze keeper progress or spend a nonce
confirmed_properties.reasoning: Scheduler acquires schedule.lock before calling observer alert.lock. These are nonblocking advisory locks, separate from the keeper lock. Backup/observer contention safely defers the unsigned job. Missing-state preconditions and selection inventories refuse rather than scheduling a fresh initialization.

confirmed_properties.property: Unstable observer inputs do not manufacture pending disappearance or recovery
confirmed_properties.reasoning: Only a validated current journal can clear/replace the existing pending fingerprint/first_seen. Final config/health/journal/source reread failures restore the prior pending observation and add an identity incident. Recovery events require healthy current health, a valid selected backup, and no reasons. Persist-before-delivery plus event IDs retains at-least-once semantics; acknowledgement is not exactly-once delivery.

confirmed_properties.property: Canonical receipt cost and nonce clear atomically
confirmed_properties.reasoning: Sender/nonce/calldata, signed fee review, receipt/header inclusion and final canonical anchors are rechecked before one deep-copied state publishes cost, next_nonce, receipt_anchor and pending=None together. Failed save restores prior in-memory state; fsync/rename ambiguity remains an explicit restart/reconciliation condition. No observer or backup writes current keeper nonce/cost state.

confirmed_properties.property: Receipt-clearing cycle is not immediately healthy metadata evidence
confirmed_properties.reasoning: A cycle starting with pending first reconciles that exact intent and deliberately skips fresh execution/confirmation metadata, so cleared pending can still produce degraded health. Only a later ordinary cycle obtains current observations. Acceptance must call health_check rather than accept a healthy-looking status string or a successful transaction alone.

confirmed_properties.property: Known confirmation deadlines have priority but no continuous-price or timing SLA
confirmed_properties.reasoning: Existing observation/reset work precedes optional workers only after pending recovery and lifecycle/authority checks. Current chain clocks and elapsed monotonic work reduce the next sleep. Slow finality, pending nonce serialization or RPC failures can still miss a strict gap; on-chain readiness/reset checks remain authoritative. Fresh policy/execution health is not proof that price remained beyond a threshold continuously between recorded samples.

limitations: No production defect was confirmed in this interaction-focused pass; no speculative source edits or new production tools were added.
Static reasoning does not prove scheduler fairness, sustained timing, host durability, provider behavior or multi-host fencing.
An advisory local lock is not protection against a hostile same-UID writer or cross-host signer.
Native composition evidence must preserve its exact fixture and scope; existing passed component bodies should not be rerun.
